# Minimal starter

Its files are in [`ext/pages/starters/minimal`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/pages/starters/minimal). See every [starter kit](https://pocketone.dev/docs/starters).

![The minimal kit's single splash page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/screenshots/starter-minimal.jpg)

A single `index.ets` page: a Tailwind (CDN) splash screen with no layout, no config and no build step. The smallest possible PocketOne app.

`.ets` is EJS whose tags hold TypeScript; Pages strips the types when it loads the page. Code files you add (a page's `.ts`, endpoints, `+middleware`, `+config`) are `.ts`.

```bash
pocketone pages create myapp --starter minimal
cd myapp
pocketone superuser upsert you@example.com <password> --dir ./pb_data
pocketone serve --dir ./pb_data
```

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8090.

## Files

```
pb_pages/
  index.ets
```

Live demo: [pocketpages-minimal.pockethost.io](https://pocketpages-minimal.pockethost.io).
